content.title: Where is Rory McIlroy from? Hometown, college, and more to know about former World No. 1  | Sporting News
content.text: Rory McIlroy is one of the most well-known golfers in the world. He first became the No. 1 ranked golfer in the world on Feb. 27, 2012. In fact, McIlroy has spent 120 weeks of his career as the top golfer in the world, with more than a year-long stretch from Aug. 4, 2014 to Aug. 10, 2015. McIlroy stands out because of his accent, but he is one of the most exciting golfers to watch play. He also partnered with Tiger Woods to bring fans the TGL, which was the indoor golf simulator league that had its first season this year. The intention was to bring golf into the modern age, and while it likely needs more time to catch on, the first season had entertaining moments. McIlroy turned pro in 2007 when he was just 18 years old. That was also the year he debuted at one of the golf majors, playing in that year's Open Championship. McIlroy won his first major four years later at the 2011 U.S. Open. 📲 Follow The Sporting News on WhatsAppHere is more on where McIlroy is from, if he went to college and the last time he won a major. Where is Rory McIlroy from?McIlroy was born on May 4, 1989 in Holywood, Country Down, Northern Ireland. He stayed local to Holywood, attending St. Patrick's and then Sullivan Upper School when growing up. McIlroy now lives in Jupiter, Florida, which is considered the golf capital of the United States, given its many courses and good, year-round weather. SN's MASTERS HQ: Live Masters leaderboard | Masters TV coverage | Live streamingWhere did Rory McIlroy go to college?McIlroy didn't go to college and instead chose to turn professional in 2007 when he was 18 years old. He had signed a letter of intent to play at East Tennessee State University, but in 2005, he became the youngest winner of both the West of Ireland Championship and the Irish Close Championship and decided to forgo the golf scholarship. MORE: How Rory McIlroy can join Tiger Woods, others in exclusive clubWhen was the last time Rory McIlroy won a major?McIlroy won the 2011 U.S. Open, the 2012 and 2014 PGA Championship and won the 2014 Open Championship. The only major that has eluded him is the Masters. The last major that McIlroy won was over a decade ago when he won the 2014 PGA Championship. McIlroy shot a 66, 67, 67 and a 68 on the par-71 Valhalla Golf Club in Louisville, Kentucky to finish 16-under. He beat Phil Mickelson by one stroke and beat Rickie Fowler and Henrik Stenson by two.
